body.name: Omega
body.type: finite family of source-state alphabets and decoding tables
body.def: \(\Omega=(\Omega_s,g_s:s\in S)\), where the explicitly listed state \(u_s\in\Omega_s\) supplies the response-table entries at the children \(\operatorname{inc}(s)\), and the combined decoder maps \(u\in\prod_s\Omega_s\) to a profile in \(\mathcal T\).
